$comment: The /welcome screen. status: "live" or "soon" (shown greyed out, labelled Coming soon, not tappable). Flip to live when the page or file ships. kind "whatsapp" opens WhatsApp with message; kind "page" links to href. roles: the dropdown under the buttons. A live role opens its page; a soon role keeps the visitor here and adds waNote to the Contact us message.
